# go.fmt-l fails on unformatted files and passes once go.fmt rewrites them;
# `package` limits both to the matching packages.
[!exec:go] skip

! bit check
stdout 'check ▶ gofmt -l'
stdout 'ugly\.go$'
! stdout 'other/'
stderr 'test target ''check'' failed'

bit fmt
stdout 'fmt ▶ gofmt -w'
cmp ugly.go ugly.go.want
cmp other/other.go other.go.orig

bit check
stdout 'check ✔ ok'

bit fmt
stdout 'fmt · no changes'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit fmt = go.fmt {
  package = "."
}

explicit check = go.fmt-l {
  package = "."
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- ok.go --
package m

func OK() {}
-- ugly.go --
package m
func  Ugly( ) int {
return 1
}
-- ugly.go.want --
package m

func Ugly() int {
	return 1
}
-- other/other.go --
package other
func  Other( ) {}
-- other.go.orig --
package other
func  Other( ) {}
